scenes.tts: A neuron's cell body and its axon share one cytoplasm. Both contain caspases. So how can caspases run in one and not the other?
scenes.visual: Title card: Same Knives, Two Routes. A neuron with caspase scissors drawn in both the cell body and the axon.
scenes.narration: A neuron's cell body and its axon share one cytoplasm. Both contain caspases. So how can caspases run in one and not the other?

scenes.tts: Caspases are proteases that dismantle a cell during apoptosis, a built-in program of cell death.
scenes.visual: Label: caspases, proteases that dismantle a cell in apoptosis.
scenes.narration: Caspases are proteases that dismantle a cell during apoptosis, a built-in program of cell death.

scenes.tts: To find out, you must deprive one place and not the other.
scenes.visual: The neuron is split by a dashed line between cell body and axon.
scenes.narration: To find out, you must deprive one place and not the other.

scenes.tts: In twenty thirteen, Corey Cusack, Mohanish Deshmukh and colleagues grew mouse sympathetic neurons in a microfluidic chamber.
scenes.caption: In 2013, Corey Cusack, Mohanish Deshmukh and colleagues grew mouse sympathetic neurons in a microfluidic chamber.
scenes.visual: Credit card: Cusack, Deshmukh and colleagues, 2013. A microfluidic chamber appears.
scenes.narration: In 2013, Corey Cusack, Mohanish Deshmukh and colleagues grew mouse sympathetic neurons in a microfluidic chamber.

scenes.tts: The cell bodies sat in one compartment. Their axons grew through narrow grooves into a second. The fluids stayed apart.
scenes.visual: The chamber fills in: cell bodies left, axons crossing grooves to the right compartment. NGF dots on both sides.
scenes.narration: The cell bodies sat in one compartment. Their axons grew through narrow grooves into a second. The fluids stayed apart.

scenes.tts: Local deprivation removes N G F from the axon compartment only. Global deprivation removes it from both.
scenes.caption: Local deprivation removes NGF from the axon compartment only. Global deprivation removes it from both.
scenes.visual: Two copies of the chamber: left labelled local, NGF gone on the axon side only; right labelled global, NGF gone everywhere.
scenes.narration: Local deprivation removes NGF from the axon compartment only. Global deprivation removes it from both.

scenes.tts: In normal neurons, what happens in each experiment?
scenes.visual: Both chambers wait, with a question mark over each.
scenes.narration: In normal neurons, what happens in each experiment?

scenes.tts: Local deprivation: the axons degenerate, and the cell bodies live. That is pruning, in a dish.
scenes.visual: Local chamber: axons fragment, cell bodies stay. Label: pruning, in a dish.
scenes.narration: Local deprivation: the axons degenerate, and the cell bodies live. That is pruning, in a dish.

scenes.tts: Global deprivation: the neurons die, and their axons go with them. That is developmental cell death, in a dish.
scenes.visual: Global chamber: cell bodies and axons fade. Label: developmental cell death, in a dish.
scenes.narration: Global deprivation: the neurons die, and their axons go with them. That is developmental cell death, in a dish.

scenes.tts: Now fill in a table, one genotype per row.
scenes.visual: An empty table: rows normal, lacking caspase-6, lacking Apaf-1; columns NGF removed from axons only, NGF removed everywhere. The normal row fills in.
scenes.narration: Now fill in a table, one genotype per row.

scenes.tts: Does axon breakdown need caspase six in both experiments? Delete it, and predict each one.
scenes.caption: Does axon breakdown need caspase-6 in both experiments? Delete it, and predict each one.
scenes.visual: The caspase-6 row is highlighted, both cells empty.
scenes.narration: Does axon breakdown need caspase-6 in both experiments? Delete it, and predict each one.

scenes.tts: Without caspase six, locally deprived axons were protected.
scenes.caption: Without caspase-6, locally deprived axons were protected.
scenes.visual: The local cell of the caspase-6 row fills: axons protected.
scenes.narration: Without caspase-6, locally deprived axons were protected.

scenes.tts: After global deprivation, the axons still degenerated as the neurons died.
scenes.visual: The global cell fills: neurons die, axons with them.
scenes.narration: After global deprivation, the axons still degenerated as the neurons died.

scenes.tts: So the two experiments have different needs. A second mutant shows whether they are two programs.
scenes.visual: The caspase-6 row stays lit; the Apaf-1 row below waits, dimmed.
scenes.narration: So the two experiments have different needs. A second mutant shows whether they are two programs.

scenes.tts: Now the other end of the pathway. During apoptosis, the protein Apaf one builds the apoptosome.
scenes.caption: Now the other end of the pathway. During apoptosis, the protein Apaf-1 builds the apoptosome.
scenes.visual: Apaf-1 proteins assemble into a wheel labelled apoptosome.
scenes.narration: Now the other end of the pathway. During apoptosis, the protein Apaf-1 builds the apoptosome.

scenes.tts: The apoptosome switches on caspase nine. Caspase nine then switches on caspase three.
scenes.caption: The apoptosome switches on caspase-9. Caspase nine then switches on caspase-3.
scenes.visual: Arrow chain: apoptosome to caspase-9 to caspase-3.
scenes.narration: The apoptosome switches on caspase-9. Caspase nine then switches on caspase-3.

scenes.tts: Local pruning needed caspase nine, caspase three and caspase six. Does it need Apaf one too?
scenes.caption: Local pruning needed caspase-9, caspase-3 and caspase-6. Does it need Apaf-1 too?
scenes.visual: The Apaf-1 row is highlighted, both cells empty.
scenes.narration: Local pruning needed caspase-9, caspase-3 and caspase-6. Does it need Apaf-1 too?

scenes.tts: No. Without Apaf one, locally deprived axons still degenerated, and the cell bodies lived.
scenes.caption: No. Without Apaf-1, locally deprived axons still degenerated, and the cell bodies lived.
scenes.visual: The local cell of the Apaf-1 row fills: axons still degenerate; cell bodies live.
scenes.narration: No. Without Apaf-1, locally deprived axons still degenerated, and the cell bodies lived.

scenes.tts: But after global deprivation, these neurons resisted death. Death of the whole neuron needed Apaf one.
scenes.caption: But after global deprivation, these neurons resisted death. Death of the whole neuron needed Apaf-1.
scenes.visual: The global cell fills: neurons resist death.
scenes.narration: But after global deprivation, these neurons resisted death. Death of the whole neuron needed Apaf-1.

scenes.tts: So in this study, caspase six mattered only for the local route. Apaf one mattered only for the global route.
scenes.caption: So in this study, caspase-6 mattered only for the local route. Apaf-1 mattered only for the global route.
scenes.visual: Two requirement lists, not chains: local route needs caspase-9, -3, -6, not Apaf-1; global route needs Apaf-1 (apoptosome), caspase-9, -3.
scenes.narration: So in this study, caspase-6 mattered only for the local route. Apaf-1 mattered only for the global route.

scenes.tts: Each route needs something the other does not. They share enzymes, but they are wired differently.
scenes.visual: Shared caspase-9 and caspase-3 glow in both lists; caspase-6 and Apaf-1 glow in one list each. On-screen line: two differently wired routes.
scenes.narration: Each route needs something the other does not. They share enzymes, but they are wired differently.

scenes.tts: Caspases become active in the deprived axon. What keeps their activity low in the cell body?
scenes.visual: Local chamber again: active caspases glow in the axon; the cell body is marked with a question mark.
scenes.narration: Caspases become active in the deprived axon. What keeps their activity low in the cell body?

scenes.tts: The same study found two things that keep caspases off in the cell body. One is X I A P, which blocks active caspase nine and caspase three.
scenes.caption: The same study found two things that keep caspases off in the cell body. One is XIAP, which blocks active caspase-9 and caspase-3.
scenes.visual: Inside the cell body, XIAP binds and blocks caspase-9 and caspase-3. Label: biochemical inhibition, not a physical barrier.
scenes.narration: The same study found two things that keep caspases off in the cell body. One is XIAP, which blocks active caspase-9 and caspase-3.

scenes.tts: The other is the proteasome.
scenes.visual: A proteasome barrel appears inside the cell body beside XIAP.
scenes.narration: The other is the proteasome.

scenes.tts: Neurons lacking X I A P built up active caspase three in their cell bodies.
scenes.caption: Neurons lacking XIAP built up active caspase-3 in their cell bodies.
scenes.visual: XIAP is removed from the cell body; active caspase-3 builds up there.
scenes.narration: Neurons lacking XIAP built up active caspase-3 in their cell bodies.

scenes.tts: Same enzymes, two wirings, and an inhibitor guarding the part that must live.
scenes.visual: Closing card: same enzymes, two wirings, and an inhibitor guards the cell body.
scenes.narration: Same enzymes, two wirings, and an inhibitor guarding the part that must live.
